what: New, the ＋: the one way a thing gets in. The ink button grows into a circle that covers the screen and its three choices rise out of it. spec/pages.md §6.4, spec/ways-out.md §6.4.

frame.who: Every seller, many times a week; Clearing out most (a pile, fast), Testing the water (What's it worth), the hunter (Find this).
frame.came_to: Say what this thing is for in one tap, then point the camera at it.
frame.costly_mistake: Picking the wrong door and losing the shots: the camera switches between Sell, Worth and Find without losing them, and × always returns the way it came.
frame.ways_out: Paste a link to a listing that already exists; describe a thing that cannot be photographed; photos already taken come in from the camera's library button.
frame.in_the_loop: Nothing here acts for the person: every choice is theirs; a pasted link or a description becomes a draft they review, never a post.

decisions: The takeover draws on the camera's bar: ink black in light, so the ＋ visibly grows into the circle, and the dark page in dark, so a full-screen light circle never flashes at night. It is the door to the camera, which wears the same ground.
The last choice used sits nearest the ×, so the thumb's shortest reach is the likeliest choice; it rises first and its icon well is the one ink circle (one emphasis per view).
Paste a link and Describe it sit above the three choices as two quiet pills, one tap off the main path, because a person who cannot photograph the thing should not have to open the camera first.
Capsules are 88 tall with a 56 icon well: 88 less 2 × 16 padding is 56, so the well's corner nests in the capsule's (Art. 9.1).
Choosing opens the camera out of the touched capsule's icon well, so the camera comes from what the finger touched (E24), in 300 ms.
A link or a description can arrive from outside (a share sheet): ?link= and ?what= prefill the sheet.

Describe it reads the words with spelling tolerance and shows the product it found under them, spelled the catalog's way ("carhart detroit" reads Carhartt Detroit Jacket J97), so a typo never reaches a title (edge-cases §3).

A typed price more than 3 times the top of the sold range, or under a third of the bottom, asks once with the range on the sheet, and the button says the price it will use; the next tap makes the draft. A price inside the range asks nothing (edge-cases §3).
